- Payment 325 and journal 1833 are 16989.66, so the extra cent sits on the payment side.
- The payment journal 1833 is DR 2000 16989.66 / CR 1000 16989.66.
- The 2000 account for this invoice currently nets to a 0.01 debit, and cash is 0.01 too low.
- To fix it, I add CR 2000 0.01 and DR 1000 0.01. This is the same pair of lines as in attempt 1, now posted against 1832.

The group of 1832 plus the correction balances, and the correction itself balances. I post it to open period 11 and change no invoice status, since this is not a duplicate invoice.
